summary: Jones Soda Co. filed an 8-K/A to correct its July 10, 2026 8-K regarding a private placement. It issued 5,257,576 units at $0.33 per unit for $1.735 million gross proceeds under Regulation D Rule 506(b). Each unit consists of one common share and a half-warrant; whole warrants are exercisable at $0.45 for 36 months, subject to acceleration if the closing price trigger is $0.73. The amendment corrects prior errors and clarifies a future non-brokered placement of up to $765,000. This is not a special situation but a routine financing, with no deal terms to track.
